articles.title: Derby County 1-2 Birmingham City: Blues hit back to win at struggling Rams
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Derby County and Birmingham City at Pride Park on Saturday; Paik Seung-ho scores the winner as Blues hit back for three points.
articles.body:
Bobby Clark put Derby ahead only for Carlos Vicente to reply minutes later and Seung-Ho won it after a lengthy stoppage for what looked like a serious injury to Derby's Henrik Meister.

Birmingham had looked the sharper side in the first half and a quick break in the 23rd minute left Derby short at the back and Vicente cut inside to unleash a shot which went narrowly wide.

Eiran Cashin almost gifted Birmingham a goal in the 29th minute with a back pass which Jacob Widell Zetterstrom just kept out with his right foot.

Derby were in trouble three minutes later when a poor clearance from Sondre Langas fell to Jay Stansfield and his shot beat Zetterstrom but hit the centre-back and bounced to safety.

The home side had created little until the 40th minute when a clever pass by Sam Szmodics found the run of Clark who beat James Beadle at his near post.

But the lead lasted just two minutes as Liam Millar crossed to the back post where Vicente got in front of Charlie Taylor to head in.

The second half was only a couple of minutes old when Meister went down off the ball on the edge of the centre circle. There was a stoppage of around seven minutes while the forward received medical attention before being taken away on a stretcher.

When the game restarted, Derby put Birmingham under pressure, forcing Beadle to turn away a Mo Fuseini shot at full stretch.

At the other end, Alex Cochrane fired in a 20-yard shot which Zetterstrom could only parry and when the ball went behind for a corner, Birmingham scored.

Miller swung the ball over and substitute Seung-Ho, who had only been on the pitch for four minutes, headed in from close range

Derby responded strongly but Birmingham were close to a third when Vicente's low shot was blocked by Zetterstrom, who then made a flying save to deny Stansfield.

Birmingham should have wrapped it up in the 89th minute when Luis Vazquez fired over an empty net from two yards after Ethan Laird's shot had been parried.

With 13 minutes of time added on, Birmingham had to hope that would not prove costly but it needed a goal-line block by a blue shirt to deny Szmodics.

Another block by Christoph Klarer denied Szmodics again and Carlton Morris saw a shot charged down as Birmingham held on.

"I thought we were excellent in large parts of the game against a very competitive team. Really disappointed in the two goals we conceded, we need to be better after getting caught in possession and then defending the far post.

"The second goal has come from a long goal kick and it's gone straight between our two centre-halves and we need to be bigger and better at defending that and then from the set-piece we obviously need to be stronger.

"I think we have to adjust and get used to each other as well, it doesn't just come from the back four it comes from the front players as well.

"We're chopping and changing the team a fair bit to try and get the right chemistry and solutions so we've got to keep working hard on the training pitch."

"I think I'm right in saying we've got the same amount of points from the same amount of games as we did last season but we've looked a completely different team.

"Not only stylistically but just the strength and mental strength we've shown and the desire. It pains me to say it but we would have lost that game last season or we would have drawn it.

"I think the trust starts to grow in the group. You go to Wrexham and win, you go to Derby and win and it says a lot of what we are capable of.

"I think anyone who plays sport or football knows those wins are the best where you've had to show that real character and grit because it makes victory taste that bit sweeter.

"It was a massive win, a win that had a bit of everything in it in terms of the way we went about it so to win it and win it in the way we did was pretty special today."

What the result means and next fixtures...

articles.title: Bolton Wanderers 1-0 Cardiff City: Thierry Gale scores last-minute winner for Trotters
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Bolton Wanderers and Cardiff City at the Toughsheet Community Stadium on Saturday; Thierry Gale nets 90th-minute goasl to seal narrow victory for the Trotters.
articles.body:
The Barbadian international stole in at the far post to convert a left-wing centre from fellow substitute Theo Bair to give Steven Schumacher's side their first three points since the opening game of the campaign.

Cardiff, along with Burnley the only Championship side without a win, will wonder how their failed to collect at least a point.

And but for Bolton keeper Gazin Bazunu the Bluebirds would certainly have shared the spoils.

Signed from Southampton last month, he made a staggering 10 saves as Wanderers climbed out of the relegation zone.

Bazunu twice denied Bluebirds' striker Yousef Salech; tipping over a first-half header and then denying the big target man another header.

And with Brian Barry-Murphy's side pouring forward in stoppage time, the one-time Manchester City prospect took his save tally into double figures by foiling Callum Robinson.

In contrast, opposite number Nathan Trott was rarely troubled as the Welsh visitors suffered a third defeat since promotion.

Salech tested Bazunu after only six minutes before the Irish international saved Chris Willock's deflected effort.

Bazunu's next highlight came after nine minutes as Ollie Tanner headed into Salech's path and the subsequent header was tipped over the bar.

It took Bolton 28 minutes to fashion a first chance with Trott less than comfortable dealing with Ruben Rodrigues' 20-yard effort.

Four minutes later, Wanderers claimed a penalty when Kyliane Dong latched onto Rodrigues' pass and went down under challenge from Trott. Referee Tom Parsons booked the winger for simulation, a decision confirmed by subsequent replays.

Team mates Ben Davies and Samuel Iling-Junior were also cautioned in a disjointed first half along with Cardiff's Joel Colwill.

Iling-Junior and Sam Dalby were replaced at half-time by match winners Gale and Bair - the latter making his home debut.

Cardiff though still looked the most likely to make a breakthrough. But they too pushed the boundaries and Perry Ng was booked for diving in the area under Gale's challenge.

Bazunu conjured up a stunning save to keep out Salech's latest attempt after the striker met Willock's left-wing delivery.

His next stop from Jack Moylan's side foot after 73 minutes was far more routine.

The contest appeared to be heading for stalemate until Gale netted his second goal of the season and Bazunu protected his clean sheet.

"You need goalkeepers who win you points and today he has done that. Cardiff created the clearer opportunities, more in the final third and better attacking play.

"When that happens, you need your goalkeeper to make a save for you. He was outstanding.

"We have been working for 18 months to get our wingers arriving at the back stick to head one in. So, we have finally done it.

"Thierry is so frustrating. It took him 20 minutes to get going. Thankfully the subs combined and Thierry was in right place to score.

"Football is mad. We played better in the previous four games but got nothing for our efforts.

"Tuesday took a lot out of us. We had to show another side of us which is really pleasing against good opponents who are one of the hardest teams to play against when you are tired."

"To be honest, we would have been disappointed talking about a draw.

"So, to be speaking after a defeat is very hard on the players and the fans. In the first half, we looked dangerous without being at our best.

"I asked the players for a lot at half-time in terms of the second half and we created enough chances to win many games.

"The players have a deep-rooted belief in how we want to play. And it means a lot to them.

"But they know we have to win. If we keep playing like we are and making chances, I am certain we will.

"We believe we are good enough to do it. I am at an incredible club and I have never felt more motivated to give them a team that they can feel proud to follow."

What the result means and next fixtures...

articles.title: West Bromwich Albion 1-1 Queens Park Rangers: Callum Styles earns point for Baggies
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between West Bromwich Albion and Queens Park Rangers at The Hawthorns on Saturday; Callum Styles scores equaliser as Baggies hit back for a point but fail in bid to go back top of the table.
articles.body:
QPR led through a Chris Mepham own goal in the 38th minute which came completely against the run of play.

That lead lasted just three minutes as Styles equalised to extend the Baggies' unbeaten home record to 11 games, while Rangers have yet to lose on their travels this season.

Albion had slightly more of the chances but the Londoners had their fair share of openings too.

Former Manchester United midfielder Toby Collyer and Conor Townsend made their first starts since rejoining Albion and defender Mepham came in to captain the side.

They were three of five changes from Wednesday's 1-0 win at Derby, the same number as the visitors.

Albion forced the early pace and Rabby Nzingoula's wayward shot came off Felix Horn Myhre, diverting the ball closer to goal but wide.

Isaac Price's inswinging corner was punched clear by goalkeeper Pierce Charles on the line as the hosts continued to press for a breakthrough.

Albion thought that had come in the 34th minute.

Aune Heggebo met Collyer's cross with a thunderous rising shot that appeared to smack the crossbar but it had hit the stanchion behind the goal.

Completely against the run of play, Rangers took the lead.

Kwame Poku sent Rumarn Burrell racing clear and he turned his man before forcing Max O'Leary into a diving save, only for the rebound to hit Mepham on the head and bounce into the unguarded net.

Albion levelled in the 41st minute when Styles, who was playing in an unfamiliar right-back role, curled home a low shot from just outside the area for his second goal of the season.

Following the restart, Price went close to putting Albion ahead for the first time, his curling free-kick tipped away by Charles.

Jayson Molumby then nodded a Styles corner a yard wide at the far post.

But they had to be wary of Rangers' threat on the break.

Poku forced O'Leary into a vital flying save after wriggling free in the box to shoot from 12 yards.

At the other end, Mepham's planted header forced Charles into a falling save from Price's corner.

Charles then had to be alert to hold Styles' low free-kick after the full-back been fouled right on the edge of the box.

Rangers threatened again when Burrell's header was smothered by O'Leary at the foot of the post from Harvey Vale's corner.

Substitute Jimmy-Jay Morgan missed the chance to win it for Albion at the death when he blazed over at the far post after heading down Molumby's cross.

"I challenged Callum. He can't just rest on being player of the season.

"He's got to go and show it again. He's been rewarded with a new contract and I didn't want him to pick the big contract up and not be at that level of performance.

"I believe in Callum so much that I think I could play him anywhere and he would be just as good.

"I said to him 'come inside onto your left foot and shoot' and it was a great finish.

"He's used to playing in midfield so he could come inside or he could stay wide.

"When he was younger he played as a winger and he's played at wing-back, so it was just about trying to get that balance right with Rabby Nzingoula (right midfielder). I thought they dealt with it really well."

"When you face a team with very good confidence and strong results it's really important to be strong in your foundation and our defensive organisation was brilliant.

"Usually we are better with the ball and are able to create more danger.

"Today it was more difficult for us to create with the ball, even if we had the best chance of the second half with Kwame Poku.

"But it was a lovely move for our goal. I enjoyed it because it was part of our game plan after the ball was regained to be able to use the space behind their centre-backs."

articles.title: Zabiri, la irrupción más importante de la Liga
articles.standfirst: El delantero marroquí se mete en la pelea por el pichichi con cinco goles
articles.summary: El delantero marroquí se mete en la pelea por el pichichi con cinco goles
articles.body: Yassir Zabiri ha sido una de las irrupciones más importante de esta Liga. El delantero marroquí anotó ante el Alavés dos goles, que sumado al hat trick frente al Elche le hacen sumar ya 5 tantos. Todos los goles hasta la fecha de Zabiri han sido en El Sardinero y han servido para sumar seis puntos. El delantero africano llegó al conjunto cántabro cedido del Stade Rennes y su rendimiento ha sido inmediato. Zabiri ha sentado en el banquillo a Villalibre y Arana y tiene pinta de dar muchas alegrías esta campaña a la afición racinguista. Zabiri empieza a recordar en estos inicios a Salva Ballesta que llegó a ser pichichi en la campaña 1999-20 con el Racing con 27 goles. El joven delantero marroquí ya fue máximo goleador del último Mundial sub 20 y fue una apuesta personal del director deportivo de la entidad cántabra Chema Aragón. Una de la claves de su eclosión en este inicio de campaña es contar con compañeros como Canales, Íñigo Vicente o Pablo García, capaces de asistirle a la espalda de la defensa. Además Zabiri ha demostrado una gran efectividad de cara a gol, aprovechando las ocasiones que ha tenido.

articles.title: El Alavés baja a la tierra en Santander
articles.standfirst: Los de Quique sufrieron la primera derrota del curso y firmaron un segundo tiempo muy discreto
articles.summary: Los de Quique sufrieron la primera derrota del curso y firmaron un segundo tiempo muy discreto
articles.body: El Alavés puso fin a su inmaculada trayectoria liguera. El conjunto de Quique Sánchez Flores cosechó la primera derrota de la temporada en El Sardinero pese a adelantarse en el marcador gracias a un gol de Ville Koski en la primera mitad. Sin embargo, los ajustes de José Alberto sacaron del túnel al equipo cántabro, que fue muy superior en el segundo tiempo y el Alavés no encontró la forma de volver a hacerse con los mandos del partido. Quique adelantó la línea defensiva y su equipo sufrió cada vez que el Racing encontraba, a base de talento y verticalidad, los pases a la espalda de la zaga. Así llegó el tanto de la igualada, con Iñigo Vicente lanzando a Zabiri para que este batiera a Sivera. Poco antes del descanso, en una acción similar, el Racing estuvo cerca de hacer el segundo. Tenía un problema serio en esa zona y Quique optó por dar entrada a Nicolás Valentini, que tampoco estuvo cómodo y cometió un gran error en el segundo gol de los locales. El argentino perdió la referencia del balón, se centró en bloquear a Zabiri, que volvió a ser decisivo para marcar dentro del área tras una gran acción entre Vicente y Salinas. Quedaba media hora larga, pero la reacción babazorra no hizo acto de presencia. El ‘Glorioso’ no fue capaz de incomodar al Racing en la segunda mitad. Los cambios tampoco tuvieron el impacto que buscaba Quique. Apenas generó situaciones de peligro en la recta final, aunque es cierto que acumuló un volumen de acercamientos considerable (16 remates) para irse de Santander con un solo gol en su casillero. Ni con Boyé y Mariano de entrada, ni tampoco en la segunda mitad con la aparición de Toni Martínez y Mañas. Al Alavés no le queda otra que pasar página y encomendarse a Mendizorroza para preparar el duelo del próximo martes ante el Valencia. Los vitorianos suman pleno de victorias en casa y quieren seguir está dinámica perfecta delante de su afición, sin olvidar la importancia de ser competitivos a domicilio. En Santander hubo fases del partido, sobre todo en el primer tiempo, en el que recordó al equipo de este arranque liguero. Pero le faltó mantenerlo en el tiempo y acabó a merced del Racing.

articles.summary: Sale Terzic con su once esperado, con Iñaki Williams como nueve y con Robert Navarro consolidándose en el extremo diestro. En el Elche, Revivo estrena
articles.body:
Última hora del Athletic - Elche en directo:

articles.title: La RFEF y las territoriales emiten un manifiesto de apoyo a Ceuta: "No estáis solos"
articles.standfirst: "El fútbol español es hoy blanquinegro y late con el corazón ceutí"
articles.summary: "El fútbol español es hoy blanquinegro y late con el corazón ceutí"
articles.body: La Real Federación Española de Fútbol y las federaciones territoriales emitieron un manifiesto este sábado para mostrar un mensaje "rotundo de solidaridad, aliento y compromiso absoluto" con la población de Ceuta y con la comunidad deportiva de la ciudad autónoma. "Querido pueblo de Ceuta: no estáis solos. Vuestra fortaleza es nuestra inspiración. Toda la estructura, la pasión y el alma del fútbol español están hoy y siempre con cada uno de vosotros. El fútbol español es hoy blanquinegro y late con el corazón de Ceuta", reza el texto ante la situación que vive la ciudad casi mes y medio después de la entrada masiva de migrantes. La iniciativa se acordó en una reunión mantenida este sábado en Gran Canaria, con motivo de la conmemoración del centenario de la Real Federación Interinsular de Fútbol de Las Palmas, presidida por el máximo responsable de la RFEF, Rafael Louzán. Los presidentes federativos subrayan que la fuerza que da organizar más de un millón de partidos cada año otorga "un altavoz único, pero por encima de todo, exige una profunda responsabilidad social". "El fútbol tiene una sola voz y su verdadera grandeza radica en su capacidad para unir a un país", añaden. A juicio del presidente de la RFEF y de las federaciones autonómicas, "los ceutíes tienen el derecho fundamental a vivir en paz, seguridad y normalidad, así como a disfrutar plenamente del fútbol, que es la expresión que muchos han elegido como motor de su día a día y como escuela de valores". "Queremos de manera unánime apoyar a todas y todos los ceutíes que hoy están pasando por momentos difíciles. Ninguna distancia geográfica ni circunstancia social nos separará de vuestro esfuerzo diario. Deseamos que la población de Ceuta pueda recuperar por completo su vida cotidiana", se enfatiza. Esta iniciativa se une a la visita que Louzán y el seleccionador nacional, Luis de la Fuente, hicieron a Ceuta el pasado día 4 para transmitir su apoyo ante la crisis migratoria y exhibir el trofeo de la Copa del Mundo. Louzán anunció entonces que Ceuta albergará próximamente un encuentro de una selección española, aunque no de la absoluta por las dimensiones del estadio Alfonso Murube.

articles.title: Quique: “Habrá partidos que jugaremos peor que hoy y ganaremos”
articles.standfirst: El madrileño destacó la actitud de sus jugadores y lamentó la falta de acierto en las áreas
articles.summary: El madrileño destacó la actitud de sus jugadores y lamentó la falta de acierto en las áreas
articles.body: Quique Sánchez Flores compareció en la sala de prensa de El Sardinero para ofrecer su visión sobre la primera derrota liguera del Alavés ante el Racing de Santander. Análisis: “Ha sido un partido igualadísimo en el que la suma de los pequeños detalles termina decantando la balanza. Sabemos que la fortaleza del Racing está en su campo. Es un equipo que acumula jugadores a un lado y catapulta balones a la espalda de la defensa. Han aprovechado su forma de jugar y han encontrado los goles como son ellos. Nosotros hemos campeado las situaciones en momentos. Ha sido un partido que acaba con 16 disparos a favor y 11 en contra. Hemos competido bien, pero no nos ha dado. Hay que hacer un partido redondo para puntuar aquí”. Falta de peligro en el segundo tiempo: “Se han cerrado mejor a partir del 2-1 y eso ha hecho que para nosotros fuera más difícil. A partir de situar a Denis de mediocentros hemos estado mejor con balón, pero no hemos generado ocasiones claras”. Cambios vinculados a las tarjetas: “Las amarillas nos condicionaban y teniendo en cuenta que hay otro partido dentro de tres días, nos parecían peligrosas las tarjetas que habíamos visto. Teníamos un riesgo con Pablo Ibáñez, que había estado al límite, y con Tenaglia, que tal y como juegan ellos, que era uno de los últimos nombres. No queríamos quedarnos con un jugador menos”. Primera derrota: “Nos enfadaremos el día que no compitamos. Mientras compitamos podemos ganar, empatar y perder. Los chicos no han estado despistados. En algunos momentos hemos sido superados, en otros ha estado igualado y en otros hemos estado mejor. Luego está el acierto en las áreas y hoy no lo hemos estado”. Aspectos positivos: “Hemos dado la cara en todo momento y hemos competido bien. Hemos tirado mucho a puerta, hemos dado sensación de peligro en muchos momentos del partido y hemos defendido bien muchas situaciones, aunque alguna se nos ha escapado. No siempre íbamos a estar en el mejor nivel posible. Habrá partidos que juguemos peor que hoy y ganemos”. Mañas: “Ha sufrido un golpe muy fuerte. Durante el partido había recuperado la conciencia. Ha sido un golpe durísimo, ha entrado con la fuerza que entra él, pero está bajo control. Le han trasladado a un hospital y se quedará aquí”.

articles.title: Danish FA allege FIFA Legal Committee evaded questions on Infantino’s plan
articles.summary: FIFA Legal Committee accused of evading questions on controversial World Cup proposal put forward by Gianni Infantino.
articles.body:
Denmark’s football chief has alleged that ‌‌FIFA declined to answer “critical questions” at a Legal Committee meeting about its proposal to sell commercial ⁠⁠stakes in tournaments, as he ⁠⁠renewed calls for President Gianni Infantino to step down.

Danish FA (DBU) President Jesper Moller said he was surprised that the now-abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise was not on the agenda and was frustrated by the ⁠⁠world football governing body’s evasive response to his inquiries.

“I naturally used the meeting to ask a number of critical questions about the process, which I still consider to have been deeply problematic,” Moller said in a statement.

“I am surprised that ⁠⁠FIFA Forward Enterprise has not been discussed by the Legal Committee, which is precisely the body that should be consulted on legal matters concerning FIFA.

“But unfortunately, it proved impossible to get answers to the questions, as FIFA wants to await the discussion at the upcoming Council meeting in October.

“This would clearly have been a good opportunity for FIFA’s leadership to explain itself.”

Al Jazeera has ‌‌contacted FIFA for comment.

The FIFA Council comprises 37 members, including President Infantino, eight vice-presidents and 28 other members elected by member associations.

“We will continue to push for answers and I am confident that we will get to the bottom of this completely unacceptable matter,” Moller added.

“The meeting confirmed that FIFA cannot rebuild its credibility under the current leadership. The time has come for a change of president at FIFA.”

‘Credible alternative’ to Infantino as FIFA President

Last month, the DBU vowed to find a credible alternative to Infantino in next year’s election , saying it had lost confidence in the Swiss-Italian ⁠⁠after his aborted proposal to sell commercial stakes in FIFA tournaments, including the World Cup.

“I ⁠⁠will continue working closely with my European colleagues to find a candidate who can command a majority. There is no trust in Infantino and FIFA’s leadership,” Moller said.

FIFA had apologised to member associations for mistakes made over the abandoned proposal, but its leadership reaffirmed support for Infantino after ⁠⁠a crisis meeting in Morocco.

The DBU said Infantino’s proposal had created “a fundamental crisis of confidence in FIFA’s leadership” that could not be repaired by withdrawals or apologies.

However, Infantino can count ⁠⁠on enough votes to win re-election , meaning his opponents will need to ⁠⁠shift strategy and focus on curbing his powers, multiple sources familiar with the discussions told Reuters.

The FIFA presidential election will be in Rabat on March 18, 2027.

Infantino’s plan prompted a global backlash, with UEFA, the Asian Football Confederation and North America’s CONCACAF among those calling for change at the top ‌‌of FIFA while the possibility of a no-confidence vote was also discussed.

Several European national associations have since withdrawn backing for Infantino’s re-election, including the French Football Federation on Thursday and Austria’s FA (OFB).

“The Supervisory Board of the OFB ‌‌unanimously ‌‌decided not to support Gianni Infantino’s renewed candidacy as FIFA President,” it said in a statement.

“The basis for this decision is the developments of recent weeks and months and the resulting significant changes in the framework conditions.”

articles.title: Mañas se quedará en observación en el hospital y no volverá con el equipo a Vitoria
articles.standfirst: El canterano sufrió un fuerte golpe en la cabeza tras una disputa con Salinas en la recta final del encuentro
articles.summary: El canterano sufrió un fuerte golpe en la cabeza tras una disputa con Salinas en la recta final del encuentro
articles.body: Las imágenes que dejaron el cabezazo entre Aitor Mañas y José Salinas dejó helada a la afición vitoriana en la recta final del partido en El Sardinero. La derrota pasó a un segundo plano tras ver cómo el canterano tenía que ser retirado del campo en camilla después de sufrir una fuerte contusión en la disputa de un balón aéreo en la que se llevó la peor de las partes. En un primer momento, Mañas se levantó del césped y trató de seguir con normalidad, pero sus compañeros y los jugadores del Racing pronto se dieron cuenta de que estaba mareado y advirtieron a los servicios médicos para que entraran a asistirle. El jugador abandonó El Sardinero consciente, pero tuvo que ser trasladado al hospital y Alberola Rojas activó el protocolo de conmoción cerebral, lo que permitió a ambos equipos hacer un cambio adicional. Todo apunta a que el fuerte golpe sufrido por Mañas quedará en un susto, aunque el jugador no volverá a Vitoria con el resto de la expedición y se quedará en Santander bajo observación. Así lo confirmó Quique en sala de prensa. “Ha sufrido un golpe muy fuerte. Durante el partido había recuperado la consciencia y está todo bajo control. Le han trasladado a un hospital y se quedará aquí”. El de Mañas fue el último cambio que introdujo Quique a falta de cinco minutos para el final. El técnico madrileño juntó al ‘20’ junto con Toni Martínez y Lucas Boyé para apostar por el juego directo y tratar de encontrar la igualada con alguna situación aérea dentro del área. No fue el caso y además Mañas tuvo que salir antes de tiempo tras dar un gran susto. Por suerte todo parece que se quedará en una fuerte contusión.

After failing to find the back of the net against Liverpool and Tottenham , the 23-year-old Delap has finally gotten off the mark for Oliver Glasner's outfit.

articles.title: Freiburg hit five against Gladbach to continue perfect Bundesliga start
articles.summary: Freiburg were firmly in control at the break against Borussia Mönchengladbach after first-half goals from Yannik Engelhardt and Igor Matanovic.Matanovic caus...
articles.body:
Freiburg were firmly in control at the break against Borussia Mönchengladbach after first-half goals from Yannik Engelhardt and Igor Matanovic .

Matanovic caused Gladbach problems almost immediately, dispossessing Ko Itakura , before having an opportunity to release Yuito Suzuki inside the opening minutes, only to struggle to get the ball out of his feet.

The breakthrough eventually arrived in the 23rd minute, when Derry Scherhant's corner found Engelhardt, whose looping header caught Moritz Nicolas in no man's land and dropped into the net.

Six minutes later, Freiburg doubled their advantage, with Matthias Ginter firing a sharp pass towards Matanovic on the edge of the penalty area and, with plenty of pace already on the ball, the striker simply guided it beyond Nicolas and in off the post.

At that point, Gladbach were in danger of being overwhelmed as Freiburg threatened to turn an already commanding first half into a rout.

Freiburg remained firmly in control after the restart, with Gladbach's hopes of finding a route back into the contest dealt another blow when Tim Kleindienst was shown a second yellow card following a coming together with Philipp Lienhart .

The visitors had already looked toothless going forward, and being reduced to ten men only made their task increasingly difficult as Freiburg continued to dictate proceedings.

And the hosts eventually made their numerical advantage count in the 76th minute. Matanovic rose to head home from close range, completing his brace and taking his tally to three Bundesliga goals for the season.

Just three minutes later, Freiburg had a fourth.

Ginter once again drilled a pass towards the edge of the penalty area, where Engelhardt took a touch before unleashing an excellent left-footed strike beyond Moritz Nicolas for his second of the afternoon.

And Freiburg were not finished there, adding a fifth late on. Jordy Makengo sent the ball across the penalty area and, following a scramble in the middle, Maximilian Eggestein was on hand to prod home and complete the rout.

It capped another hugely impressive display from Julian Schuster's side, who have now won each of their opening three Bundesliga matches while conceding just once.

With Augsburg dropping points against Bayer Leverkusen elsewhere and Freiburg's second-half goal rush, Die Breisgauer climbed to the top of the Bundesliga to cap a remarkable start to the campaign.

For Gladbach, meanwhile, a woeful start to the season continues.

Eugen Polanski's side remain without a point after three matches, with a miserable afternoon in Freiburg compounded by Kleindienst's dismissal and five goals conceded.

articles.title: Schick rescues Leverkusen as Augsburg surrender perfect start
articles.summary: Bayer Leverkusen took a deserved lead into the latter stages of the first half against Bundesliga leaders Augsburg, with Christian Kofane rewarding an increa...
articles.body:
Bayer Leverkusen took a deserved lead into the latter stages of the first half against Bundesliga leaders Augsburg , with Christian Kofane rewarding an increasingly threatening display from the visitors.

Augsburg actually created the first opening inside the opening minute, as Robin Fellhauer 's low delivery found Hennes Behrens at the far post, only for Facundo Medina to make an important block.

Leverkusen quickly began to grow into the contest, however, with Moussa Diaby causing problems down the right and Kofane heading an Aleix Garcia corner narrowly wide.

Ibrahim Maza was next to threaten, driving into the penalty area before seeing a left-footed effort blocked, while Finn Dahmen was called upon to deny a further Leverkusen opening after Medina picked out a run in behind.

The visitors eventually made their pressure count in the 18th minute, when Kofane converted following an assist from Edmond Tapsoba to put Carles Martinez's side in front.

Seconds into the second half, Augsburg would begin to threaten again, with Bayern Munich loanee Arjon Ibrahimovic sending a powerful effort past the post, coming close to stunning the visitors.

This would not be a flash in the pan either, with Die Fuggerstädter holding on to the momentum.

Just a matter of minutes later, Hennes Behrens slipped in Michael Gregoritsch , before the experienced forward poked the ball under the onrushing Mark Flekken to level the score at the WWK Arena.

And within five minutes, the hosts had put themselves ahead.

After rounding off the win against Frankfurt, Fabian Rieder was at the centre of things again, with Gregoritsch meeting his ball into the box to find the back of the net his second in no time at all, leaving Manuel Baum's side top of the league for the time being.

Leverkusen thought they had produced an immediate response less than four minutes later, when Maza's effort from the edge of the box took a deflection off Rieder and found the back of the net. However, Augsburg were given a reprieve after a VAR review.

Leverkusen continued to push for an equaliser, and their pressure finally paid off as Patrik Schick rescued a point for the visitors.

Malik Tillman fired the ball back into the penalty area, where Schick produced an excellent backheel finish to guide it beyond Dahmen and level the contest at 2-2.

It denied Augsburg a third successive victory, but Baum's side remain unbeaten after an impressive start to the campaign and sit third in the Bundesliga after taking seven points from their opening three matches.

For Leverkusen, meanwhile, the late equaliser ensured they avoided a second defeat of the season, although their own mixed start continues.

Carles Martinez's side sit sixth after recording a win, a draw and a defeat from their opening three Bundesliga fixtures.

articles.title: Fábio Silva y un 'tijeretazo' de Felix Nmecha impulsan al Borussia Dortmund

articles.summary: El ex de Las Palmas 'abrió la lata' y el internacional alemán se reivindicó con un doblete
articles.body: El Borussia Dortmund ha comenzado con buen pie. Los de Niko Kovac cuentan sus cinco partidos (tres de Liga, uno de Copa y otro de Champions) por victorias. El triunfo sobre el recién ascendido Paderborn (3-0) les sitúa colíderes de la Bundesliga con nueve puntos de nueve posibles, los mismos que el Friburgo. Fábio Silva no se hizo esperar. Apenas habían transcurrido cinco minutos cuando marcó el 1-0. Robó Svensson, filtró al espacio Guirassy y el ex de Las Palmas regateó al meta Noll para marcar a placer con la zurda. Cuatro goles y una asistencia suma el portugués en los cinco partidos que ha disputado en este inicio de curso. Se le resistió el segundo al Borussia Dortmund, en especial a Guirassy. El guineano vio cómo le anulaban dos nuevos goles... por fuera de juego. El primero en el 31', tras una bonita pared con Fábio Silva; y el segundo, en el añadido del primer tiempo, al cabecear un centro de Svensson. El 'BVB' parecía empeñado en complicarse. Nwaneri (59') y Guirassy (62') fallaron dos mano a mano casi consecutivos. Los paró Noll, mejor dicho. Por suerte apareció Felix Nmecha en el 80'. El medio, que entró sustituyendo a Veerman en el 62', recibió de Beier y se lanzó solo a la aventura. Recortó a Djuric y se acomodó el balón para marcar con un gran disparo al palo largo. Golazo. Hubo más. Sabitzer se estrenó con el larguero en el 84', pero se redimió sirviendo un gran centro a Felix Nmecha para que anotara el definitivo 3-0 en el 89'. El internacional alemán rubricó el envío con un espectacular remate de tijera.

articles.body:
It turns out last week's controversial close call has dampened the enthusiasm around Ann Arbor for Michigan football.

The get-in price for Saturday's game at the Big House between Oklahoma and Michigan is down to $39 with Sooners fans apparently taking advantage of the low cost based on the amount of maroon around the stadium.

It's not hard to understand why Michigan fans may not be eager to watch their team play against the No. 11 team in the nation right now.

The Wolverines survived last week on a second Hail Mary attempt against Western Michigan that only came about after the officials put one second back on the clock even though it appeared time had expired on the first shot at the end zone.

Michigan dropped from No. 16 in the AP preseason poll to outside the Top 25 as a result of the narrow win over Western Michigan.

Kickoff between Oklahoma and Michigan from the Big House is scheduled for 12 p.m. ET on Saturday.

articles.summary: El equipo de Carles Martínez Novell vio cómo le remontaban y terminó rescatando un punto
articles.body: El Bayer Leverkusen se llevó un punto de su visita al Augsburgo (2-2)... y gracias. El 'equipo de la aspirina', que comenzó ganando, vio cómo le remontaban y terminó igualando en el 89'. Reparto de puntos que deja al tercero al Augsburgo -llegaba líder- con siete puntos y sexto al Leverkusen, con cinco. Los pupilos de Carles Martínez Novell, que alineó de inicio a Miguel Gutiérrez y Aleix García y dejó en el banquillo a Lucas Vázquez, se adelantaron en el 18' gracias a un buen gol de Christian Kofane. El ex del Albacete 'cazó' un gran pase de Tapsoba a la espalda de la defensa, controló con la diestra para sacarse de encima a Matsima y fusiló a Dahmen con la izquierda. Sin embargo, el sorprendente Augsburgo está de dulce. Michael Gregoritsch aprovechó un pase al hueco de Behrens para, mano a mano, salvar la salida de Flekken con un sutil toque y devolver el empate al marcador en el 50'. Un incomprensible fallo de marcaje dio pie al 2-1 en el 55'. El Leverkusen dejó libre de marca a Gregoritsch, probablemente el mejor cabeceador del Augsburgo, y el austríaco no falló. Remató a la red, en el segundo palo, el envío de Rieder para anotar su tercer gol en Liga. Volvió a empatar el Leverkusen en el 60' con un disparo desde la frontal de Ibrahim Maza... pero el gol no subió al marcador. El VAR decretó falta previa de 'Equi' Fernández sobre Rieder. El asedio del Leverkusen, ya con Schick (63'), Tillman (75') y Lucas Vázquez (85') sobre el césped, encontró premio en el 89'. El 2-2, de hecho, nació en una internada de Lucas Vázquez por derecha. Centró el ex del Real Madrid, despejó la defensa, empaló Malik Tillman desde la frontal y marcó Patrik Schick con un gran recurso de tacón para poner el definitivo 2-2.
